Mode_A.name: Neutral Baseline LLM
Mode_A.purpose: Measure underlying LLM ability to understand SOC incidents without policy directives or semantic validation.

Mode_B.name: Approved Policy LLM
Mode_B.purpose: Measure effect of approved rule-specific prompt policies on the exact same model and evidence.

Mode_C.name: Full Validated Pipeline
Mode_C.purpose: Measure incremental effect of deterministic semantic validation and trustworthiness guardrails.

experimental_relationships.Mode_A_vs_Mode_B: Measures net impact of approved rule-specific prompt policy on LLM classification.
experimental_relationships.Mode_B_vs_Mode_C: Measures net impact of independent deterministic validator and guardrails.
experimental_relationships.Mode_A_vs_Mode_C: Measures combined impact of prompt policy and independent validation relative to raw baseline.
